one_line: Ladakhi Buddhist exile who seized the throne of Kashmir after the Mongol raid and ruled briefly as the first Muslim sultan.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean and athletic, with a wiry but regal bearing
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, light brown Himalayan complexion, straight sharp nose, thin neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, intense almond-shaped dark eyes, default expression calm and watchful with a subtle strategic half‑smile
appearance.hair: straight dark brown hair, medium length, pulled back and tied at the nape in a narrow leather band, with a simple dark blue woolen Ladakhi-style cap (skullcap with a low rounded crown) sitting snugly on his head
appearance.costume: He wears a Ladakh-influenced quilted chuba-style long coat in muted deep maroon wool, crossing left over right and belted at the waist with a wide dark brown leather belt, over a pale cream linen tunic with long fitted sleeves; the coat hems and cuffs have narrow dark blue borders, and over one shoulder he drapes a soft grey woollen shawl for Kashmir’s chill, while his lower body is covered by straight loose trousers in dull charcoal grey tucked into sturdy mid‑calf leather boots in dark brown; around his neck is a simple string of small wooden prayer beads and a single silver pendant, and his overall textiles are wool and linen with very minimal patterning, just fine geometric trim at the edges.
appearance.signature: A single slightly curved Central Asian-style sword (early sabre) with a plain steel blade, a dark wooden hilt, and a simple brass crossguard, worn at his left hip in a brown leather scabbard with subtle tooling and no excessive ornament.

ref_desc: Rinchan Shah has an oval high-cheekboned light brown face, tied-back dark brown hair under a dark blue cap, a maroon quilted chuba coat over cream tunic with grey shawl, charcoal trousers, brown boots, and a simple curved sword at his hip, in maroon, blue, grey, cream and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Rinchan Shah: an early-30s, lean Ladakhi-Kashmiri ruler with an oval high-cheekboned light brown face, intense almond dark eyes, and neatly trimmed moustache and short beard, his straight dark brown hair tied back and covered by a simple dark blue woolen skullcap. Show him in a historically grounded early 14th-century Himalayan-Kashmir outfit: a deep maroon quilted chuba-like long coat that crosses left over right, belted snugly at the waist with a wide dark brown leather belt, worn over a pale cream linen tunic with fitted sleeves. The coat’s cuffs and hems have narrow dark blue borders and very fine geometric trim. A soft grey woollen shawl drapes over one shoulder, and his lower body is covered by loose charcoal grey trousers tucked into sturdy mid-calf dark brown leather boots. Around his neck, include a modest string of small wooden prayer beads and a single silver pendant. At his left hip, show his signature slightly curved Central Asian-style sword in a plain brown leather scabbard, with a simple steel blade, dark wooden hilt, and brass crossguard. Use a restrained palette of deep maroon, dark blue, charcoal grey, cream, and dark brown, and pose him neutrally, front-facing, with clear views of face, hair, garments, boots, shawl, and sword for consistent redrawing.
